subject: Security evidence readiness: SSO, audit logs, and keyflow deep-dive
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara@helixhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
Cc: security@helixhealth.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: security architecture deep-dive (SSO, audit logs, KMS)

Hi Ben,

We're preparing for our internal SOC 2 scoping and want to run a focused architecture review with Redwood. Primary topics: SSO mapping and assertion flow, audit-log ingestion/retention, and KMS/key rotation for encrypted artifacts. Can we schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive next week? Ideal attendees from our side: me, Arun (platform/security eng), and our compliance lead.

Preferable windows: Wed 6/21 AM PT or Thu 6/22 PM PT. If those don't work, let us know alternatives. Also — we'll need an evidence checklist (what artifacts we should pull beforehand) and a short list of who from Redwood should join (arch, security, and someone who owns evidence handoff).

Thanks,
Tara
Tara Singh
Head of Security Operations, HelixHealth
[Attachment: helix_sso_mapping.csv (CSV)]

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: Tara Singh <tara@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.example>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.example>
Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security architecture deep-dive (SSO, audit logs, KMS)

Hi Tara — great to hear from you and happy to run this. Thanks for the windows; we can do Wed 6/21 10:00–11:15 AM PT (75 min) or Thu 6/22 3:00–4:15 PM PT. Please confirm which you prefer and we'll send a calendar invite.

Attendees from Redwood I propose: Kimberly Park (Technical Account Lead — security/compliance), Mina Haddad (Solutions Architect — infra/encryption), and me for project coordination. If you'd like an engineering onsite (runtime/logs owner) we can add Neha.

I've attached a preliminary SOC 2 evidence matrix and a short pre-read on our KMS/keyflow and audit-log retention. If you can share your SSO mapping (the CSV you attached is perfect), we'll mark the items we expect to cover and flag any additional artifact requests ahead of the meeting.

Proposed agenda (quick):
- 10 min: introductions & goals
- 25 min: SSO assertion flow and mapping / where tokens live (who signs what)
- 20 min: Audit-log collection, retention, and access controls (ingestion, retention windows, searchability)
- 15 min: KMS keyflow, rotation, and evidence we can provide
- 5 min: next steps & evidence handoff owner

Attachments: redwood-soc2-evidence-matrix.xlsx, redwood-keyflow-diagram.pdf

Looking forward — Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood-soc2-evidence-matrix.xlsx (XLSX)]

Thanks — sounds good. We can do Thu 6/22 3:00–4:15 PM PT. I've added Arun to the thread. We also need the following before the session so our compliance team can review:
- A one-page KMS keyflow diagram specific to the Redwood integration (how keys are generated/stored/rotated)

I'll confirm the names from our compliance lead later today and send a calendar invite for Thu 3:00 PM PT. If Kimberly can't make it, Mina covering is fine — please make sure someone can speak to the hot-path for audit-log exports (Neha?).
